newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso claws back to close at 1,099.90.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso claws back to close at 1,099.90.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed up 1.10 pesos against the dollar at 1,099.90, interbank dealers said.
Dealers said the peso firmed on an influx of petrodollars near the end of trading, adding that throughout much of the session supply had been matched by demand for greenbacks.
Dealers said they expected banks to shorten dollar positions, pushing the peso up to about 1,095 against the dollar in the near term.
The peso opened at 1,101.5 and dipped to 1,102 before reaching its intra-day high of 1,099.50. Dealers reported 357 trades worth $176 million.
